name: Watchtower
dimensions: Diameter: 39 cm (15 3/8 in.); Overall: 54.3 cm (21 3/8 in.)
summary: In this funerary sculpture of the watchtower is a lively retinue of hunters, musicians, dancers, and domestic animals. The representation provides a vivid picture of the worldly enjoyment to be perpetuated in the otherworldly realm of the afterlife. A low-temperature lead glaze is applied to its ear
